# rust-migration

把 C/C++、Fortran、Java、Python、Shell 等遗留代码迁移到 Safe Rust：分析、规划、迁移、PGO 与遥测报告。

| 类型 | 名称 | 说明 | 来源 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| skill | `migrate-to-rust` | Clones, analyzes, plans, and migrates legacy codebases (C++, Fortran, Java, Python, C, Shell) from a GitHub URL or local directory to a modern, high-performance, deterministic, 100% Safe Rust architecture, tracking live telemetry across every task bucket, test failure/fix cycle, and Profile-Guided Optimization (PGO) stage, and producing a first-person AI storytelling report and interactive HTML infographic. Use when migrating a GitHub repository or local codebase to Rust, porting legacy C++, Fortran, Python, or Java workloads to memory-safe Rust, designing Struct-of-Arrays (SoA) or SIMD Rust architectures, or optimizing Rust ports with LLVM PGO. Don't use for unrelated non-Rust refactoring or single-line syntax questions. | [google/skills](https://github.com/google/skills/tree/main/skills/developers/migrate-to-rust) · Apache-2.0 |
